changes.name: SkyboundAreaHUD
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local p=Players.LocalPlayer
local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui");gui.Name="SkyboundAreaHUD";gui.ResetOnSpawn=false;gui.Parent=p:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local label=Instance.new("TextLabel");label.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(340,50);label.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-170,0,70);label.BackgroundTransparency=.25;label.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);label.TextStrokeTransparency=.3;label.TextScaled=true;label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;label.Parent=gui
local areas={{"GRASSLANDS",0,1000},{"WATERFALL ISLES",3000,1000},{"DESERT TEMPLE",6000,1000},{"FROZEN PEAKS",9000,1000},{"VOLCANO REALM",12000,1000},{"CELESTIAL CITY",15000,1000},{"VOID REALM",18000,1000}}
local last=""
while task.wait(.35) do
 local root=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if root then
  local best,bestd="GRASSLANDS",math.huge
  for _,a in ipairs(areas) do local d=math.abs(root.Position.Z-a[2]);if d<bestd then bestd=d;best=a[1] end end
  if best~=last then
   last=best;label.Text=best;label.TextTransparency=0;label.BackgroundTransparency=.25
   task.delay(2.5,function() if last==best then for i=1,10 do label.TextTransparency=i/10;label.BackgroundTransparency=.25+(i/10)*.75;task.wait(.04) end end end)
  end
 end
end
